heading: Sunday
text: Sun filtering through increasing high clouds. Chance of afternoon showers near the Massachusetts border, becoming likely late, with a rising chance up to around Route 4. Highs from the upper 50s to mid 60s, south to north, some upper 60s possible in the St. Lawrence Valley. Winds becoming south 5 to 15 mph, and gusting to 30 mph from the Green Mountains westward.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Showers likely from the Adirondacks and Route 2 south, heaviest near the southern border. Lows in the mid 40s to lower 50s, mid 50s around Burlington. South to southeast winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Monday
text: Mostly to partly cloudy. A few lingering showers southeast, otherwise cloudy with occasional breaks of sun. Rain returns from the north very late. Highs in through the 60s north to south, low 70s far south. Winds becoming west to northwest 5 to 10 mph.
